query catalogCategoryByCode($categoryCode: String!) {
  catalogCategoryByCode(categoryCode: $categoryCode) {
    id
    parentId
    parentCode
    name
    shortDescription
    description
    fullDescription
    image
    lottie
    imageOffsetX
    imageOffsetY
    imageScale
    color
    weight
    iconUrl
    tariffTitle
    code
    size
    type
    availabilityType
    tags
    classId
    subjectId
    coursesObjectIds
    externalMaterial
    hidden
    isActive
    practiceId
    durationMinutes
    validFromDate
    validToDate
    practiceId
    bannerComponent
    updatedAt
    educont
    educontOnly
    educontCourses {
      externalId
      label
      link
    }
    randomizedContent {
      classId
      subjectId
      taskQuantity
    }
    showKeys
    teacherThemeGroupMode
    eor
    badges
    about
    additionalInfo
    name
    childCategories {
      ...catalogCategoryFields
    }
    aiConfig {
      audioTitles {
        autogenerate
        takePauses
        voice
        speed
      }
    }
  }
}

fragment catalogCategoryFields on Category {
  id
  parentId
  parentCode
  name
  shortDescription
  description
  fullDescription
  image
  lottie
  imageOffsetX
  imageOffsetY
  imageScale
  color
  weight
  code
  size
  type
  availabilityType
  tags
  classId
  subjectId
  coursesObjectIds
  externalMaterial
  hidden
  isActive
  practiceId
  durationMinutes
  validFromDate
  validToDate
  practiceId
  bannerComponent
  updatedAt
  educont
  educontOnly
  iconUrl
  educontCourses {
    externalId
    label
    link
  }
  randomizedContent {
    classId
    subjectId
    taskQuantity
  }
  showKeys
  teacherThemeGroupMode
  eor
  isPurchased
  tariffTitle
  aiConfig {
    audioTitles {
      autogenerate
      takePauses
      voice
      speed
    }
  }
}

query shopCatalog {
  shopCatalog {
    groups {
      ...subscriptionGroupFlatFields
    }
    subscriptions {
      ...subscriptionFields
      design
    }
  }
}

fragment subscriptionGroupFlatFields on SubscriptionGroupFlat {
  id
  name
  type
  shortDescription
  longDescription
  iconUrl
  backgroundColor
  role
  weight
  subscriptions
  subscriptionsImages {
    id
    imageUrl
  }
  parentId
  bannerType
  bannerPosition
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionFields on Subscription {
  id
  name
  role
  type
  description
  weight
  createDate
  updateDate
  deleteDate
  labels
  displayCardIcon
  displayCardSize
  plans {
    ...subscriptionPlanFields
  }
  discounts {
    id
    type
  }
  configuration {
    subjectIds
    categoryIds
    chatRequests
    giftChatRequests
    tasksCount
    studentsQuantityInClassroom
    unlimitedAccessToTeachersTasks
    hintsForTeachersTasks
  }
  classObjectId
  specialLabel
}

fragment subscriptionPlanFields on SubscriptionPlan {
  id
  numberOfStudents
  pricingPolicy
  period
  price
  timeline
  priceBefore
  pricePerMonth
  pricePerMonthBefore
  discount
  quotaOfTasks
  coins
  subjectPrices {
    id
    subjectId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
  categoryPrices {
    id
    categoryId
    name
    priceBefore
    pricePerMonth
    pricePerMonthBefore
    discount
  }
}
